entities.title: Unit tests and the branch-coverage gate
entities.summary: zazz-script-runner's unit tests run with the workspace's; CI fails unless its branch coverage, test code excluded, reaches 95%. daemon's zazz tests also use the release build of zazz-script-runner.
criteria: Every unit test in the crate passes; the tests build their WebAssembly from hand-written text (the wat dev-dependency).
Branch coverage of the crate, test code excluded, is at least 95%.
The crate builds with its own rust-version; the rest of the workspace is checked on Rust 1.85 without it.

checks.description: CI runs it within `cargo test --workspace` on macOS and Linux, after `cargo build --release -p zazz-script-runner`, which daemon's zazz tests need.

checks.command: sh daemon/coverage.sh 95 zazz-script-runner (in src/macos; nightly with cargo-llvm-cov and the wasm32-wasip1 target)
checks.description: Reads the branch percentage from cargo llvm-cov's summary and fails below 95. Test modules are marked coverage(off).
Checks the workspace on Rust 1.85 with zazz-script-runner excluded, since wasmtime needs a newer Rust.
